policy.backend_policy: custom traits always implemented internally; bridge traits prefer optional native effect if resolved and equivalence is verified, else native Minecraft fallback. Only visible Food Blessing status; any backend potion applied with particles=false and icon=false, exact JEM ownership, collision-safe; never hide other mods native effects.
policy.source_consumption: server player only, successful completed native item use or verified successful placed-block bite; 22 block routes known, no unverified RightClickBlock awards
policy.no_native_mutation: Keep original food hunger/saturation/effects, NBT, recipes, remainders and drop behavior; no food balance by replacing upstream attributes
policy.quality_no_retroactivity: Any vanilla/optional item absent at runtime remains a harmless dormant catalog assignment. Quality never depends on effect-mod availability.
policy.replacement: new enhanced meal replaces existing owned Food Blessing bundle; ordinary food does not clear; native_only enhanced food clears old food blessing but preserves native effects
policy.same_dish_refresh: re-eating the same registry ID refreshes no timer unless current bundle remaining <=20% of its initial duration; no stacking; trait-specific cooldowns not reset
policy.global_effect_status: one actual MobEffect per player; no 30 separate MobEffect ids; display dynamic trait list on hover via client inventory effect tooltip extension
policy.death_policy: remove Food Blessing; keep variety timestamps and cooldowns across death; do not copy attribute modifiers as permanent
policy.format: all numeric timings in game ticks (20 ticks/sec), display friendly seconds and localized descriptions
policy.source_definition: 2026-10-24 source includes 848 unique IDs, no live gameplay verification; category placement remains an authored decision even if recipes indicate otherwise; verify runtime routes before claiming verified
